thread:
alex: quick follow-up to the pinning metadata RFC. Were hitting header bloat for top tenants. need a compact request hint shape.

sam: agreed. sending full rollout blobs on each placement call is the culprit.

jordan: idea: send only a short digest prefix + an affinity hint, keep full rollout in control-plane sync. saves bytes.

lee: must define deterministic collision tie-breaks. clients + resolver must converge.

maria: minimal request hint example i sketched:

```
pin_prefix: sha256:abcd12
affinity: 0.78
pin_version: v3
```

alex: tradeoffs: simpler clients, more resolver logic, need telemetry for ambiguous matches.

sam: also we should forbid tiny prefixes. recommend min_prefix_len=6 hex chars (48 bits) to avoid accidental collisions.

jordan: resolver rule proposal: (1) exact id match, (2) longest prefix match, (3) highest affinity_score, (4) lexicographic final tie-break. Documented and tests required.

lee: storage: store canonical full_id in DB, index precomputed prefixes to make lookup fast. Don't persist ephemeral prefix-only records.

maria: expiration: include pin_epoch or digest_version so resolver can reject stale prefixes.

alex: for wire format let's use compact TLV binary in header (base64) and let gateway expand for logging. keeps wire tiny, logs readable.

sam: need metrics: prefix_resolve_rate, ambiguous_resolve_count, fallback_reason. Add alerts when prefix_resolve_rate > 0.5% per tenant.

jordan: migration: accept both full_pin_id and pin_prefix; prefer full_pin_id when present (backcompat). Start advisory mode, rollout behind feature flag, canary top tenants.

lee: action owners: lee -> TLV prototype + client shim; maria -> DB changes + manifest linter to enforce min_prefix_len; jordan -> RFC tie-breaks + telemetry; alex -> feature-flag plan + canaries; sam -> gateway header size cap and alerting.

deploy-bot: @alex initiated canary rollout for prefix-hints behind ff at 2024-11-12T15:02Z :rocket:

alex: last note: gateway must reject overly large header blobs (hard cap) so we never regress. will add to PR checklist.

sam: ok closing here, will track PRs in RFC thread. :thumbsup:
